templates.name: Technology Survey
templates.content:
## Technology Survey Checklist

- [ ] Countries where the company operates.
- [ ] Location of company headquarters.
- [ ] Number and locations of company offices.
- [ ] Total number of employees.
- [ ] Number of owned data centers.
- [ ] Location and type (owned or outsourced).
- [ ] Who operates the data centers?
- [ ] Cloud services? GCP? AWS? Azure? Number of tenants/accounts
- [ ] Cloud-to-on-premise site connectivity.
- [ ] Ranges of public IP addresses.
- [ ] Firewall used – brand and model.
- [ ] Remote access:
- [ ] VPN – technology used.
- [ ] Two-factor authentication?
- [ ] Citrix access? MFA?
- [ ] Access via RDP or RDS?
- [ ] Administrative access using tools like TeamViewer or similar?
- [ ] Third-party access (vendors)
- [ ] VPN?
- [ ] Site-to-Site VPN?
- [ ] External public infrastructure:
- [ ] Main applications
- [ ] Applications? Web servers?
- [ ] Web services?
- [ ] Use of WAF?
- [ ] Email solution? On-premise or cloud?
- [ ] Internet browsing – On-premise proxy?
- [ ] Do servers have proxy configured?
- [ ] Workstations?
- [ ] Remote workstations? Cloud proxy?
- [ ] Antivirus used?
- [ ] EDR?
- [ ] SIEM? Brand – Model.
- [ ] Internal / External? Who manages it?
- [ ] How do logs reach the SIEM? Do they go through Elastic?
- [ ] Internal segmentation? VLAN?
- [ ] WiFi in the organization? Authentication?
- [ ] Virtualization? VMware? Hyper-V?
- [ ] Number of hypervisors?
- [ ] Backup
- [ ] Backup solution
- [ ] Servers? OS and versions
- [ ] Active Directory architecture?
- [ ] Main databases
- [ ] Do the networking, datacenter, IT admins use a single machine? Do they use a Jump server?
- [ ] Main applications.
- [ ] What is the mail infrastructure like?
- [ ] How is it distributed? Cloud, local, hybrid mail? Macro-level structure
- [ ] Data leakage prevention solutions? DLP?
- [ ] Mobile devices. Do they have corporate devices? How are they managed? Is MDM implemented?
